Both desks and tables display q = 0.90. Bed quality is 1.00 and wardrobe labels show the configured storage unit. Dimension arrows and titles are legible.
Both the PNG and rendered PDF show the three households on the 8–20 m² grid with a common 0–1 adequate-share scale.
The commuter and couple panels distinguish the catalogue S2 and the optimized selected vector, whose dimensions are the catalogue. The parent-and-child panel shows three strategies.
Legends, axes and the equally weighted shell caption are legible. The figure displays the scenario rates, with the paired area intervals reported in the tables.
